programmes.d: Matt and Chester get caught in the middle of a feud between Indians and buffalo hunters.
Matt must find out who sent a supposed professional killer to Dodge and why.
An ex-slave is bribed by two desperados to steal an important document from a wounded Matt Dillon.
The new saloonkeeper in Dodge is a woman who knows how to handle a six-shooter.
A woman is torn between the man she loves and the one her father picked for her.
A farmer whose credit has run out gets a loan from Marshal Dillon and Festus Haggen, then loses the money in a poker game.
Half-breed Quint Asper's bravery causes a haughty Army colonel's daughter to change her attitude toward Indians.
Matt saves the life of a white boy raised by Indians who was shot trying to retrieve horses stolen from his tribe.
When an old Indian scout murders a man, Matt pursues him into Comanche territory.
A discouraged dirt farmer decides to leave his farm and try to become a man like Marshal Matt Dillon.
A local farmer joins a posse and is criticized and punished for shooting an outlaw in the back.
Matt is reluctant to tell Cherry O'Dell that her husband's been killed.
A peaceful cowboy enjoys a false reputation as a gunfighter until he must decide whether or not to fight for a pretty girl.
Matt hunts down two drifters who dragged Chester and left him for dead.
Two old ranch partners have a falling out.
Matt tracks down a gunman who robbed a stagecoach Barry Atwater, Jolene Brand, and George Cisar appear.
A one-time outlaw tries to go straight with Matt Dillon's help but a beautiful woman leads him to a disastrous end.
A stranger is purchasing all the local freight lines.
Belle Ainsley returns to Dodge, but does not receive a warm welcome.
Kitty gets deserted in a desolate plain by a suitor she rejected.
Deputy Newly O'Brien is attracted to a vivacious young lady, unaware that the lovely charmer has a crimson past.
A vengeful ex-convict seeks reprisal against a former partner-in-crime who ran out on a train holdup.

Five nuns bring a wounded outlaw into Dodge City, then are reluctant to turn him in because he saved their lives.
A bewhiskered water witch shows up in Dodge City during a drought and promises to find water despite the skeptics.
Matt is used by an old friend in a con game.
Matt helps a woman whose suitors are about to duel for her affections.
A lovesick, broke transient embarks on a lucrative but perilous career-boiling nitroglycerine off dynamite for a gang of robbers.
Matt Dillon hunts a gang that has shattered one safe after another with nitroglycerine.
Doc Adams fights to prevent three newborn babies from growing up in an orphan asylum.
The brother of an outlaw Matt killed swears revenge.
A man keeps beating his wife after she pays the fine for his jail time.
